sourceNotes.rawContent: Brighten your ensemble with this premium yellow enamel kada featuring a central pearl accent. Expertly crafted with a high-quality gold finish, its anti-tarnish and water-resistant properties ensure long-lasting brilliance. This chic, modern statement piece offers a luxurious aesthetic that maintains its stunning luster through everyday wear.
